# Unitec USA Design — Comprehensive Technical & Architectural Documentation

## Executive Overview
Unitec USA Design is an international manufacturer and wholesale exporter of advanced architectural composite materials headquartered in Miami, Florida, USA, with regional manufacturing and operational facilities in Colombia (Itagüí, Medellín) and supply networks extending through Panama, Mexico, Costa Rica, and the Caribbean.

The company specializes in:
1. High-Density PVC Architectural Sheets (mármol PVC, paneles decorativos, tejas termoacústicas UPVC).
2. WPC (Wood-Plastic Composite) Architectural Fluted Panels, Decking, and Exterior Louvers.
3. Rigid Core SPC (Stone Plastic Composite) Waterproof Flooring.
4. Preserved and High-Grade Synthetic Biophilic Green Walls (Jardines Artificiales).

## Technical Properties & Material Performance
- **Composition**: Up to 60% recovered calcium carbonate / mineral stone composite, 30% virgin & recycled PVC polymer matrix, and 10% thermal stabilizers, UV blockers, and pigments.
- **Maintenance**: Zero maintenance. No protective varnishes, sealants, anti-fungal chemical treatments, or sanding required over lifespan.
- **Fire Rating**: Class B1 fire-retardant performance under international building standards. Self-extinguishing upon flame removal with low smoke toxicity emission.
- **Moisture & Water Ingress**: 100% waterproof and moisture-impervious. Zero swelling, warping, or delamination in high-humidity tropical or marine environments.
- **Biological Resistance**: Immune to termite infestation, wood-boring insects, mold, mildew, and fungal growth.
- **Sustainability & Environmental Footprint**: 100% recyclable at end-of-life. Produced without hazardous heavy metal plasticizers (lead-free, formaldehyde-free).

## Commercial & Logistics Operations
- **Fulfillment Model**: Full Container Load (FCL) wholesale distribution. Unitec ships standard 20ft and 40ft High Cube (HC) maritime containers directly to client port of entry or jobsite warehouse.
- **Headquarters USA**: Doral / Miami, Florida, USA.
- **Headquarters Colombia**: Carrera 42, Autopista Sur #75-83, C.C. IDEO Local 274, Itagüí, Antioquia, Colombia.
